title: Mandatory Government Security Vetting for Personnel with Access to Singapore’s Critical Information Infrastructure
what_it_is: Mandatory Government Security Vetting for Personnel with Access to Singapore’s Critical Information Infrastructure

sections.label: CII access controls and monitoring
sections.summary: The Cybersecurity Act requires CII owners to implement access management controls, monitor for anomalies, and investigate unauthorised activity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Under the Cybersecurity Act, owners of CIIs are required to put in place access management controls and processes to monitor for anomalies and suspicious activities in these systems.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Upon detection of any unauthorised activity, CII owners are required to investigate such anomalies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Digital Development and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: These controls mitigate potential insider threats or any other threats.

sections.label: Zero trust and least privilege
sections.summary: Zero trust means designing access controls for least privileged access, always verifying users, and monitoring suspicious behaviour.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Thirdly, in cybersecurity, today we operate with the concept of zero trust, meaning that you decide in terms of how you architect the access controls, and you provide what is known as least privileged access, for every single one who has access to the system, you design the access controls in such a way that they only access what they are supposed to access in order to get the job done.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Then, you need to put in place a robust system so that you never trust, you always verify whether a user is accessing the part of the system that they should access.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Then, you need the system to monitor, to look at suspicious behaviour, whether there was a user that attempted to go beyond the access privileges that were granted.

sections.label: Vetting of CII personnel
sections.summary: The passage asks about extending requirements to CII personnel, notes requirements are not publicly revealed, and states vetting exists.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: Why not we extend that to CII personnel as well?

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But we do not publicly reveal all the requirements that we put in place, and that is for obvious security reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Then, that becomes the easiest thing to overcome.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: It is not the case that there is no vetting.
